entries.text:
15 shots with just a one single prompt.

Seedance 2.0 is here to dominate 🔥

Prompt:

FORMAT: 15s / 145 BPM / 15 SHOTS / beat-synced routine

SUBJECT: @[image1] < ATTACH YOUR IMAGE.

WARDROBE: Sleep tee and lounge shorts at home. Tailored jacket, fitted top, trousers, and lace-up shoes outside.

ENVIRONMENT: Tiny apartment, bright fridge glow, rain-dusted hallway, chrome metro, clean office, then a bedroom in cool window light. Everything feels glossy and lived-in.

MOOD: Late-for-work panic, clipped momentum, breathless urgency, then an exhausted exhale.

MUSIC: Fast percussive electro-pop

COLOR LOGIC: Hyperreal Pop Look

STYLE: Ultra-Realistic.

LOGIC RULE: Keep logical consistency in wardrobe, props, locations, and action continuity across all shots.

SHOT 1: ECU, 85mm push-in / 06:50 on the phone screen as it shakes on rumpled sheets. / SFX: alarm, sheet rustle.

SHOT 2: WS, 35mm handheld jolt / Rhythmic cut into her jolting upright through side light, throwing the blanket aside, and planting her feet on the floor in one rushed motion, still in a soft sleep tee and lounge shorts. / SFX: mattress bounce, blanket whip, sharp breath.

SHOT 3: MCU, 50mm slide / Cut on action into face wash at the sink, droplets catching the top light. / SFX: faucet rush, water slap.

SHOT 4: Insert shot, 85mm rack focus / Match cut into the toothbrush held at a natural forward brushing angle against the front teeth, hand relaxed and upright, mint foam and mirror eye. / SFX: bristle scrape, sink drip.

SHOT 5: Interior fridge view, 24mm wide / Object pass into the camera inside the fridge looking out as the door snaps open and her hand darts in, blue fridge light framing a hurried grab for breakfast ingredients. / SFX: fridge hum, bottle clink, shelf rattle.

SHOT 6: Insert shot, 50mm handheld / Rhythmic cut into eggs and toast hitting the pan under warm practical light. / SFX: butter sizzle, chop tap.

SHOT 7: MCU, centered 50mm push-in / Match cut into one rushed bite, a quick clock glance, and an immediate rise from the chair. / SFX: crunch, ceramic clink, chair scrape.

SHOT 8: Bird's-eye insert, 35mm overhead / Cut on action into striped socks snapping on. / SFX: fabric stretch, heel tap.

SHOT 9: MS, 35mm pivot / Camera wipe into a rushed outfit change as the sleep tee disappears under a fitted top and tailored jacket, then her tote, keys, and transit card get scooped up in one messy grab. / SFX: fabric whip, key jingle, zipper pull, bag rustle.

SHOT 10: Insert shot, 50mm overhead / Match cut into lace-up shoes slamming on as the laces yank tight in one impatient pull. / SFX: sole thump, lace tug, short breath.

SHOT 11: WS, 24mm parallax / Whip pan transition into her, now in the tailored outside outfit, rushing through the apartment door into corridor light without breaking stride. / SFX: latch click, rapid footsteps, hallway air.

SHOT 12: MS to CU, 35mm glide into 85mm push-in / Sound bridge into the metro car interior only as she grips the pole, shifts with the carriage sway, checks the passing station lights, and snaps a tense glance toward the closing doors, reflected chrome streaking around her and the city smearing outside the window. / SFX: rail clatter, carriage screech, door warning chime, tight breath.

SHOT 13: Insert to MCU, 50mm snap zoom / Smash cut to the office entrance as her access card hits the reader, the glass door unlocks, and she slips through fast before the chair roll and laptop open. / SFX: badge beep, door click, laptop chime.

SHOT 14: OTS, 35mm handheld / Rhythmic cut into fingers racing across keys, chat windows blinking, coffee by the trackpad, and notifications stacking faster than she clears them. / SFX: keyboard burst, notification ticks, mouse click.

SHOT 15: WS, 50mm pull-out / L-cut with a match from laptop close to apartment re-entry as the jacket drops, work clothes peel away, and she changes back into sleepwear before collapsing into bed in the opening frame shape. / SFX: door shut, bag drop, fabric rustle, blanket rustle, room tone.

Photorealistic cinematic music-video shot, 30 seconds, 24fps, realistic human movement, overcast natural daylight, subtle film grain, shallow-to-medium depth of field, high-end cinema camera look.

CHARACTER REFERENCE RULES — IMPORTANT:

Reference Image 1 = LEAD CHARACTER ONLY.
Use the first provided reference image as the exact identity and appearance of the lead. Preserve his exact face, facial features, hairstyle, body proportions, height, and yellow duck costume with hood, orange duck feet, and white belly panel. Do not change his outfit into a suit or white jacket.
Reference Image 2 = BACKGROUND DANCERS ONLY.
Use the second provided reference image as the visual reference for the background dancers. The dancers should wear the same black formal imperial-secretary-inspired uniforms with gold embroidery, white lace collars, fitted black trousers, tall black boots, and elegant period styling. Preserve the black-and-gold costume design and overall aesthetic from Reference Image 2.

Do not mix the character designs. The lead comes exclusively from Reference Image 1. The background dancers come exclusively from Reference Image 2.
Characters

Lead:
The exact person from Reference Image 1. He is the only character wearing the bright yellow duck costume. He stands out strongly against the dark background dancers.

Background dancers:
40–60 dancers filling the environment. They all follow the costume and visual design language of Reference Image 2. Their appearances can vary naturally in age, face, hairstyle, and physical build while maintaining the same black-and-gold uniform aesthetic. They form a large, intimidating, perfectly organized formation.

0.00–3.00s — Tight frontal close-up
Camera locked on the lead's face and upper torso at eye level, with subtle handheld micro-sway.

The lead from Reference Image 1 faces the camera wearing black rectangular sunglasses. He has a cigarette in his mouth.
He slowly exhales a thick cloud of white smoke that drifts across the lens.

At 1.0s, he raises his right hand, gold rings visible, takes the cigarette between his index and middle fingers, and takes another short drag.

At 2.2s, he lowers the cigarette and looks slightly down toward the camera with a serious frown.

Behind him, heavily blurred, is a massive wall of dancers wearing the black-and-gold outfits from Reference Image 2. They stand completely motionless.

3.00–4.20s — Head and body turn

The lead lowers his gaze and slowly turns his head and torso to his right, screen left.

The camera stays tight and smoothly follows the movement.

His yellow duck costume remains clearly visible and unchanged.

4.20–9.50s — Walking into the formation

The camera pulls backward into a medium-wide over-the-shoulder tracking shot.

The lead slowly walks forward into the dense formation of black-and-gold dancers.

The dancers remain completely still, creating the feeling of a living wall.

The camera moves backward at exactly the same speed as the lead, keeping him centered.

As he moves deeper into the formation, more and more rows of dancers become visible.

A large brick building and architectural archway slowly appear in the distant background.

9.50–13.80s — Threading through the crowd

The lead continues walking between two columns of dancers.

Several dancers make a subtle half-step to allow him to pass, but otherwise remain almost completely frozen.

Their expressions stay serious and controlled.

The camera continues tracking backward while slowly rising, revealing the enormous scale of the formation.

By 13 seconds, the lead is deep inside the crowd.

13.80–16.50s — The center

The lead stops.

He slowly pivots 180 degrees until he faces the camera again.

He is now standing perfectly in the center of the formation.

The camera transitions into a locked-off wide shot, slightly looking upward toward the staircase.

The entire formation is symmetrical.

The lead's bright yellow duck costume is the only strong visual contrast against the black-and-gold dancers.

He takes another slow drag from the cigarette as smoke curls around his face.

16.50–20.80s — Complete stillness

Hold the wide symmetrical composition.

The lead remains almost completely motionless, smoking.

Every dancer remains completely frozen.

The scene feels unnatural and tense.

At approximately 20.5 seconds, tiny movements begin appearing throughout the formation.

Dancers subtly shift their weight.

A few heads move almost imperceptibly.

The tension builds.

20.80–22.50s — Choreography ignition

On a sharp musical beat, the entire group suddenly explodes into synchronized movement.

The dancers clutch their chests and collars with both hands.

They twist their torsos sharply and snap their heads in different directions.

The movement is aggressive, precise, synchronized, and perfectly timed.

The lead does not participate.

He remains completely upright and calm in the center, smoking and watching the dancers.

22.50–26.20s — Bow wave

The dancers suddenly fold forward into a deep synchronized bow.

Their heads whip downward and snap back upward.

Some dancers clutch their uniforms while others throw their heads toward the sky.

The movement travels through the formation like a powerful wave.

The camera remains completely locked in the wide shot.

The entire staircase of dancers moves violently around the single stationary yellow duck-suited lead.

The lead calmly takes another slow drag.

Smoke drifts upward around his face.

26.20–30.00s — Final movement and freeze

The dancers repeat the bowing, torso twisting, clutching, and head-whipping choreography two more times.

The movement gradually becomes more chaotic while remaining tightly synchronized.

At the final beat, everyone suddenly freezes.

Some dancers remain deeply bent forward.

Some are half-risen.

Others stare upward or directly toward the camera.

The lead remains standing perfectly still in the exact center, cigarette in hand.

Final frame: a symmetrical army of black-and-gold dancers surrounding the single yellow duck-suited lead.

Visual requirements

Photorealistic. Cinematic. Real human skin and fabric. Realistic physics and body movement. Natural lighting. Subtle film grain. No 3D animation. No cartoon look. No anime. No exaggerated CGI. No character morphing. No identity changes. No outfit changes. No extra lead characters.

Reference Image 1 controls the lead. Reference Image 2 controls the dancers. Keep both character designs completely separate throughout the entire video.

Quick cut to the front empty passenger-side red leather door panel and seat back, trees rushing past the window. Same interior palette and motion.

Soft overcast light, shallow depth of field, trees softly out of focus behind him.

Exterior shot at window height, slightly behind and to the side of the moving white convertible on the paved forest road. Chrome side mirror sits in the foreground. Trees and the yellow-lined road recede behind the car. Gentle tracking or locked-off follow so the car and his face stay composed. Wind moves his hair and the open shirt slightly.

Soft vintage-car engine drone, tire hiss on damp asphalt, light wind through the trees and open window. No extra score, no crowd, no dialogue besides the sung lines. Natural room tone inside the cabin. No background music

entries.text:
【K-POPダンスルーティン動画テンプレ】
AIダンス、動かすより「振付をつなぐ」方が難しい。
今回は動きが断絶されないようにプロンプトを工夫してみました。
ポーズの連続にならないように、
・腰→胸→肩へ動きを流す
・腰のうねりは腰アップ
・表情は顔アップ
・最後も止まらず次のステップへ
この考え方で、Seedance 2.5用の15秒・Girl Crushテンプレを作りました。
（Seedance2.0もかなりいいです！）
女性の実写キャラ画像を参照に入れて使えます！
背景や動きは自由にいじって遊んでみてくださいー！
というか髪の動きが自然すぎて。。。😲
プロンプト全文は以下です。
↓
＜プロンプト＞
【生成する映像】
参照画像の成人女性1人が踊る、実写Girl Crush K-popダンスMVの連続した15秒。
長い楽曲と振付の途中を切り取った映像。冒頭より前からパフォーマンスが続いており、15秒の後も踊り続ける。

女性的で官能的なしなやかさと、力強い踏み込み、大きな腕の動きを両立する。
